ForeFlight confirmed layoffs to streamline operations but called reported 30-50% figures misleading and overstated.
Thoma Bravo bought Jeppesen and ForeFlight from Boeing for $10.55 billion and combined them into one Denver-based business.
Organizational changes follow Thoma Bravo's acquisition of ForeFlight and Jeppesen from Boeing.
Company points to low turnover rate and strong benefits as signs of a stable workplace.
